# PRUDEV II — Enterprise Improvement Plan (TBIP) BGE Rollout Email Template

**Usage**: Broadcast via the Admin / Programme Manager Dashboard Communication Center (or directly via email/SMS) to all active Business Growth Experts (BGEs).

---

### Email Subject
`Action Required: Enterprise Improvement Plan (TBIP) Rollout & Monthly Coaching Roadmap`

---

### Email Body
Dear {{name}},

I hope this email finds you well and progressing smoothly with your field engagements.

As part of strengthening our Business Development Services (BDS) under PRUDEV II, we have launched a new tool on the BGE Portal: the **Enterprise Improvement Plan (MSME Business Assessment & Technical Business Improvement Plan - TBIP)**.

---

### 1. PURPOSE & STRATEGIC IMPORTANCE
Conducting this diagnostic assessment and formulating the TBIP is now **mandatory for each of your assigned MSMEs**.

The TBIP serves as the **strategic foundation and operational roadmap guiding your 3 monthly coaching visits per MSME**. Every visit and intervention you carry out should directly track and address the priority gaps identified in this plan.

---

### 2. KEY STEPS IN THE ASSESSMENT PROCESS
When conducting the assessment with your MSMEs, please complete the following steps directly in the portal:

1. **7-Dimension Diagnostic Assessment**: Complete the guided questionnaire covering *Governance & Strategy, Financial Management, HR & Decent Work, Market & Customers, Digital & Technology, Environmental Sustainability, and Regulatory Compliance*.
2. **Gap Analysis & Observations**: Review the auto-computed health status and record concise notes on the critical challenges identified.
3. **Priority Action Roadmap (3–5 Actions)**: Agree on 3 to 5 high-impact, measurable actions with the MSME owner, specifying the responsible lead, expected timeline, and target outcomes.
4. **BGE Sign-Off & Submission**: Complete your BGE sign-off and submit the assessment through the portal.

---

### 3. REVIEW & APPROVAL MEETINGS
Once you submit the Enterprise Improvement Plans for your assigned portfolio:
- We will schedule an **individual review meeting with you** to walk through the identified diagnostic gaps, evaluate the proposed action plans, and grant final approval.
- You can also export and print the official branded PDF report or Excel workbook directly from the portal for your reference and to share with the enterprise owner.

---

### 4. NEXT STEPS & TIMELINES
Please log into the BGE Portal, navigate to the **"Improvement Plans (TBIP)"** tab (or launch directly from your MSME card), and begin conducting the assessments during your upcoming field visits.

Should you have any questions or require guidance on navigating the tool, please reach out directly.

Thank you for your continued dedication to supporting our MSMEs.

Best regards,  
**PRUDEV II BDS Team**  
GOPA Pro / GIZ

---

### SMS Broadcast Version
> `Dear {{name}}, please log in to the PRUDEV II portal to complete the new Enterprise Improvement Plan (TBIP) for your assigned MSMEs. This forms the basis of your 3 monthly visits. We will schedule a meeting to review and approve your submissions. — PRUDEV II BDS Team`
